title: SKE Crystal Plus Grape Prefilled Pods 20mg
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Grape flavour SKE Crystal Plus prefilled pods deliver the deep, rich taste of freshly picked grapes, bursting with natural sweetness and smooth, juicy undertones. A classic fruity flavour that’s as indulgent as it is satisfying, Grape is an ideal choice for vapers who love bold and juicy flavours. Compatible with the SKE Crystal Plus Pod Kit, these prefilled pods bring all the convenience of disposable vapes while offering a more sustainable and user-friendly experience. Sleek, portable, and mess-free, they’re perfect for on-the-go vaping. Each pod comes prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, providing a smooth and satisfying throat hit with faster nicotine absorption. The advanced 1.1ohm mesh coil ensures consistent vapour production and a deliciously rich MTL (Mouth-To-Lung) draw. Please Note: SKE Crystal Plus pods include a protective seal that must be removed before use. Detach the bung from the top of the mouthpiece and allow the pod to sit for 5-10 minutes to ensure the coil is fully saturated with e-liquid, preventing dry hits or burnt coils
